"""Reproduce ticket #16661 scenario: lookup_allowed() with FK as primary key."""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=[
        "django.contrib.contenttypes",
        "django.contrib.auth",
        "django.contrib.admin",
        "modeladmin",
    ],
    USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()

from django.apps import apps
from django.contrib.admin import ModelAdmin
from django.db import models

app_config = apps.get_app_config("modeladmin")


class Country(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=256)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "modeladmin"


class Place(models.Model):
    country = models.ForeignKey(Country, models.CASCADE)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "modeladmin"


class Restaurant(models.Model):
    place = models.OneToOneField(Place, models.CASCADE, primary_key=True)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "modeladmin"


class Waiter(models.Model):
    restaurant = models.ForeignKey(Restaurant, models.CASCADE)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "modeladmin"


class WaiterAdmin(ModelAdmin):
    list_filter = ["restaurant__place__country"]


from django.contrib.admin.sites import AdminSite

site = AdminSite()
ma = WaiterAdmin(Waiter, site)
result = ma.lookup_allowed("restaurant__place__country", "test_value")
print("lookup_allowed('restaurant__place__country') ->", result)
assert result is True, "FAIL: lookup_allowed returned False (bug present)"
print("PASS: ticket scenario fixed")
